title: Add editorconfig configuration
body:
This ease collaboration and enforces things like:

* indentation style
* strip white space
* always add an empty line

Example:

```
root = true

[*]
indent_style = space
indent_size = 2
end_of_line = lf
insert_final_newline = true
trim_trailing_whitespace = true
```

WDYT?
